item.title: Waiting Well Through Unanswered Prayers - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Unanswered prayers do not always end in the hoped-for miracle, but they can still reveal grace, endurance, and the quiet redeeming work of Christ.

item.title: Soft Power and the Church’s Humanitarian Work - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Soft power flows from Church service that funds trusted partners, builds local trust, and multiplies humanitarian work across many communities.

item.title: Worship and Service Belong Together - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Worship and service belong together because devotion to God forms the sacrifice, endurance, and mercy that make care for others last for years.

item.title: Restoring Dignity in Political Leadership - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Political leadership grounded in human dignity strengthens democracy, lowers polarization, rebuilds civic trust, and renews shared civic purpose.

item.title: Protective Factors for Child Sexual Abuse That Work - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Protective factors for child sexual abuse include education, healthy marriage ties, attentive caregiving, community support, and faith safeguards.

item.title: Hard Times, Halfway Hope: The 3½ Pattern - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Hard times expose the middle of discipleship: 3½ marks bounded suffering before God intervenes, shaping hope through obedience, trust, and love.

item.title: Why Independent Voters Still Need Political Parties - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Independent voters may forfeit real power outside party structures, where primaries and local meetings often decide who can govern and lead.

item.title: Hope for the Early Returned Missionary - Public Square Magazine
item.description: An early returned missionary may feel marked by loss, yet spiritual growth and renewed purpose can rise through grace from an unexpected return home.

item.title: How to Be Present and Hear God More Clearly - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Discipleship deepens when we learn how to be present before God, resist distraction, and offer fuller attention to worship, love, and daily faith.

item.title: 4 Things Media Bias Charts Aren’t Measuring Yet—And Why They Matter
item.description: Bias charts miss some of the subtler bias that matters: framing, access, and scale. From AP’s “bigger than Notre-Dame” to skewed abuse pieces, we expose distortions shaping faith coverage—and how to fix them.

item.title: Secret Lives of Mormon Wives and Moral Chaos - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Secret Lives of Mormon Wives reveals how fame, sexual autonomy, and family breakdown turn private wounds into profitable public spectacle and shame.

item.title: Understanding Sexual Violence Risk Factors - Public Square Magazine
item.description: Sexual violence risk factors include trauma, instability, addiction, and disconnection from family, community, and faith.
